citations.quote: How many points will be scored?

This market resolves to Yes if Northeastern and Butler collectively score over 166.5 total points in the men's college basketball game between Northeastern and Butler scheduled for 2026-11-19 at 6:00 p.m. CT. Otherwise, it resolves to No. The Underlying is the total points scored by both teams for the specified game. Source Agencies, in order, are the league governing the event (NCAA), ESPN, Fox Sports, and the official broadcast partner of the event. If the Expiration Value cannot be determined on the Expiration Date (including because the event is cancelled or a team forfeits, withdraws, or is disqualified), the Exchange may determine payouts pursuant to the Market Outcome Review Process.
